## Problem

Is your request related to a problem? e.g. "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or features you have considered, and why you
prefer the proposed one.

## Example

A snippet showing what the config, CLI invocation, or output would look
like once the feature lands. Code blocks are very welcome.

## Additional context

Anything else that might help — links to other tools that do this well,
concrete use cases, the size of the audience that would benefit, etc.
